name: Banke Bihari Temple Complex & Lanes
notes: Narrow heritage lanes (Kunj Galiyan); bottleneck risk at VIP and general exit gates.

name: Mathura Junction Railway Station
notes: Major junction connecting Delhi-Mumbai-Agra; Platform 1-3 concourse passenger surge during weekend express arrivals.

name: Prem Mandir Campus & Front Plaza
notes: Wide open marble courtyards; manageable flow with evening musical fountain and illumination peaks.

name: Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Outer Security Corridor
notes: Multi-tiered frisking and baggage checkpoints; queuing area at Gate 1 and Gate 3.

name: Mathura ISBT Bus Terminal (Old & New Bay)
notes: Interstate transit hub for Delhi, Jaipur, Agra, and Aligarh buses.

name: Dan Ghati / Govardhan Parikrama Entry Point
notes: Parikrama circumambulation circuit start node; heavy weekend and Ekadashi pilgrim footfall.
